answer: Only identities that keep producing auditable work arrive at the lantern of payment, so volume alone buys nothing. Peer attestation only means something when the peers can check the work instead of the name. Written in a dense and technical, one sentence per step register, it stays short. A nadir of per-task receipts records who did what, and the atlas of that record is inspected by auditors who gain nothing from passing it. The design leans on per-epoch sampling audit, converted to a slow vesting stream, each submission carries a fresh nonce.
